items.raw_excerpt: A site swap between a village school and a playing field might be a solution for the former, which needs rebuilding.

items.raw_excerpt: With temperatures rising across Germany recently, you've probably seen a lot more pesky wasps, fruit flies and mosquitos. Here's what you can do to keep them at bay.

items.raw_excerpt: Tapas are an intrinsic part of Spanish eating culture, consisting of small plates of food shared with friends or family along with drinks. There are some fascinating theories about how this typically Spanish way of dining came to be.
items.summary_en: Tapas are small plates of food shared with friends or family along with drinks. They are an important part of Spanish eating culture. There are interesting theories about how this way of dining came to be.
items.summary_ko: 타파스는 친구나 가족과 음료와 함께 나누어 먹는 작은 요리입니다. 스페인 식문화에서 빼놓을 수 없는 자리를 차지하고 있죠. 이 독특한 식사 방식이 어떻게 생겨났는지에 관한 재미있는 설들이 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Kuruvai paddy coverage in Tamil Nadu's Cauvery delta declines by over one lakh acres due to significant water shortages.

items.title_original: Kuruvai coverage in Tamil Nadu’s Cauvery delta is down by over one lakh acres due to water shortage
